author: John Hammond
description:
What looks like a legitimate copy of TortoiseSVN turns out to be anything but.

By comparing the suspicious installer with the real software, I walk through the differences that stand out, including mismatched timestamps and unexpected network traffic. Those clues point toward DLL side-loading and malware communicating with remote infrastructure.

Full video: https://youtu.be/NIi4i9IjshM?si=xBA1adt1tjFJfnIH
title: Backdoored TortoiseSVN Installer
